Used the original Nitrokey HSM model on a code-signing server project. The applet running inside is not free/open source but dev tools and documentation are top notch, integration with OpenSC is very good. Nice to configure escrow of key material offline (AES-encrypted paper backup), unlike Gemalto HSMs.

I'm currently using both Nitrokeys and YubiHSMs on a client project. Nitrokeys can't do Ed25519, stuck with NSA Suite B for ECC. Attestation certs can't be exported via PKCS#11, must use custom vendor shell; baked-in cert is RSA2048 in a non-standard ASN.1 container format.

I wish they would make something that felt more durable. I bought the U2F key and the combination of plastic and not being sure where to press left me with a very flimsy feeling. Compared to my Yubikey the quality is night and day.
Unlike some competitors, Nitrokey contains a complete and standard compliant USB plug... Here I am waiting for a Type-C from them. Yet they claim that's a good thing. What utter bullshit.
To install the driver, you may need to allow the installation of unsigned drivers first. Nope, thanks.

My Yubikey 5 NFC rocks. Just works. I ordered a Nitrokey 3C NFC 2 years ago, never heard from them until a week ago where they said they shipped it. Support answered rudely to a status inquiry. They claimed many features 2 years ago but still haven't reached feature parity with Yubikey.
I hesitated between both, but the nitrokey 3 has so many things listed as "planned" that I went for a Yubikey (bought a 5a NFC and a 5c NFC).

Author here: extracting Nitrokey HSM RSA private keys is not a vulnerability per se - it requires the attacker to already have the keys to the castle (DKEK), but it still defeats the purpose of the HSM.
Nice to see Nitrokey afloat - a small company serving the demands of us, FOSS centric folks. Was nice to get my own Nitrokey free of charge from a similar deal with Gentoo Linux 2 years ago.
I've been tracking Nitrokey for a couple of years now, and am really impressed with the products they offer. Their Nitrokey HSM is available for only 70 euros (compare to YubiKey HSM at 600 euros).
